problem: At the city aquarium, a keeper tosses 3 fish to each penguin at breakfast time. The penguin pool has 9 penguins. How many fish does the keeper toss out at breakfast?
follow_up_questions: A fresh bucket held 45 fish before breakfast. How many fish remain in the bucket afterwards?
How many extra penguins could get their breakfast from the fish still in the bucket?

problem: How many sugar cubes does Mrs. Delacroix need for her 9 ponies if every pony gets 3 cubes after its riding lesson?
follow_up_questions: Her sugar tin had 45 cubes in it. Once the ponies have had their treat, how many cubes are still in the tin?
With the cubes left over, how many more ponies could each get the usual treat?

problem: For the school garden fair, the children potted 29 sunflower seedlings and 25 tomato seedlings. A teacher lined all the pots up in rows of 6. How many rows of pots were there?
follow_up_questions: By closing time, 4 whole rows had been sold. How many pots were left?
The leftover pots were shared equally among the 3 classes. How many pots did each class take?

problem: How many rows of 6 can a librarian make from 29 new picture books and 25 new comic books if she stands every one of them on the display table?
follow_up_questions: Readers check out 4 full rows. How many books remain on the table?
She divides the remaining books equally among 3 classrooms. How many books does each classroom receive?

problem: At the craft store, Tobias spent 86 cents. A pencil cost him 25 cents and an eraser 19 cents. The rest paid for 6 identical stickers. How much was one sticker?
What was the price of one marble? Priya paid 86 cents in total at the toy stall: 19 cents for a bouncy ball, 25 cents for a whistle, and the remainder for 6 marbles that each cost the same.
During the summer, Amira read 5 comic books, and each one had 12 chapters. The one about the space pirates made her laugh the most. How many chapters did she read in all?
follow_up_questions: Afterwards she rereads 8 chapters she liked. How many chapters has she read altogether now?

problem: Find the total number of songs Dmitri practised on the piano this term. His teacher gave him 5 songbooks, with 12 songs in each one. The cover of one songbook was bright purple.
follow_up_questions: Next he practises 8 of the songs again for a concert. What is the number of songs he has practised in all now?

problem: A gardener wants to put a fence all the way around a vegetable bed that is 15 feet long and 11 feet wide. How many feet of fencing does she need?
follow_up_questions: She builds 2 beds just like it. How many feet of fencing do both beds need?
There are already 64 feet of fencing in her shed. How many more feet must she buy?

problem: How much tape does Mr. Osei need to go around the whole edge of a poster board, if the board is 15 inches long and 11 inches wide?
follow_up_questions: His class is making 2 of these posters. What total length of tape is needed?
The tape roll in his drawer holds 64 inches. How many more inches of tape does he need?

problem: A tailor unrolls a length of cloth and finds it is 84 inches long. Since a foot is 12 inches, how many feet of cloth does she have?
follow_up_questions: She uses 3 feet to make a scarf. How many feet of cloth remain?

problem: There are 12 inches in every foot. How long, in feet, is the 84-inch rope that a sailor coils on the deck?
follow_up_questions: He cuts 3 feet off to tie up a small boat. How many feet of rope does he have left?

problem: A little train at the zoo leaves the station every 6 minutes, carrying 4 visitors each trip. How many visitors ride the train in 30 minutes?
follow_up_questions: A ticket costs 3 dollars per visitor. How much money does the train collect in that time?
The driver uses 15 dollars of it to buy fuel. How much money is left?

problem: In 30 minutes, how many kids can go down the giant water slide if a raft carrying 4 kids is sent down every 6 minutes?
follow_up_questions: Every kid pays 3 dollars for the slide. What does the slide earn in those minutes?
Out of that money, 15 dollars pays for new rafts. How much remains?

problem: Leo empties his toy cars onto the carpet before his cousins come over. There are 56 cars from his shelf and 37 from a box in the closet. How many cars can they play with?
follow_up_questions: The cousins line up all but 18 of the cars to make a traffic jam. How many cars are in the traffic jam?
The traffic jam has 3 lanes, each with the same number of cars. How many cars are in each lane?
One lane is cleared, and they refill it with 6 fewer cars than before. How many cars make up the traffic jam now?

problem: What is the number of seashells Marisol can use for her sandcastle? Her bucket holds 56 shells from yesterday, and this morning she found 37 more along the beach.
follow_up_questions: She presses all but 18 of the shells into the castle walls. How many shells are in the walls?
The walls form 3 towers with the same number of shells on each. How many shells are on one tower?
A wave knocks down one tower, and she rebuilds it using 6 fewer shells. How many shells are on the castle now?

problem: A toy farm set has 6 boxes of animals, and each box holds 5 plastic cows. Ayesha wants to paint black spots on all four legs of every cow. How many legs will she paint?
Mateo has to glue a rubber foot onto all 4 legs of every chair for the doll house. The kit has 6 packets, with 5 chairs in each packet. How many rubber feet does he glue on?
Before the swimming gala, Tariq swims 3 lengths of the pool each day. How many lengths will he swim in 4 weeks?
follow_up_questions: At the gala he swims 6 more lengths. What is his total number of lengths now?

problem: In 4 weeks, how many pages will Yuki have filled if she writes 3 pages of handwriting practice every single day?
follow_up_questions: On the day of the handwriting contest she writes 6 more pages. How many pages has she written altogether?

problem: A banner for the school fair needs 45 gold stars. The art teacher already has 18 large stars and 16 small stars in a drawer. How many more stars does she need to buy?
follow_up_questions: Each extra star costs 3 dollars. How much will she pay for them?

problem: How many more chairs must the hall manager rent? The concert needs 45 chairs, and the hall already has 18 folding chairs and 16 wooden chairs.
follow_up_questions: Renting one chair costs 3 dollars. What is the cost of renting the extra chairs?

problem: At the funfair, Greta wants to go on three rides: the swings cost 8 tickets, the bumper cars 6 tickets and the ghost train 9 tickets. She already has 5 tickets. How many more tickets does she need to buy?
follow_up_questions: Two tickets cost one dollar. How many dollars does she spend on the tickets she needs?
She hands over a 20-dollar note. What change does she receive?

problem: Rafael has only 5 stickers, but he wants to trade for three posters: a robot poster worth 8 stickers, a dinosaur poster worth 6 and a rocket poster worth 9. How many more stickers must he get?
follow_up_questions: The shop sells 2 stickers for one dollar. How many dollars does he pay for the stickers he needs?
If he pays with a 20-dollar note, how much change is he given?

problem: A group of 5 children and 3 adults visits the aquarium. Entry costs 4 dollars per child and 7 dollars per adult. How much does the group pay to get in?
follow_up_questions: They hand over a 50-dollar note. What change do they receive?
With the change they buy fish-shaped cookies at 3 dollars each. How many cookies can they buy?
Each child wants a cookie. How many children do not get one?

problem: What does it cost for 3 grown-ups and 5 kids to go to the cinema, if a kid's ticket is 4 dollars and a grown-up's ticket is 7 dollars?
follow_up_questions: They pay with a 50-dollar note. How much change comes back?
The change goes on popcorn tubs costing 3 dollars each. How many tubs can they buy?
Every kid would like a tub of their own. How many kids miss out?

problem: The bakery delivered bread this morning using 4 bikes and 2 cars. Each bike carried 35 loaves and each car carried 90 loaves. How many loaves were delivered?
follow_up_questions: By midday the shops had sold all but 75 of these loaves. How many loaves were sold by midday?

problem: How many boxes of apples left the orchard today? Each of the 2 lorries took 90 boxes, and each of the 4 trailers took 35 boxes.
follow_up_questions: By evening, every box except 75 had reached the markets. How many boxes reached the markets?

problem: For the museum outing, 22 students sit at 9 picnic tables. Every table seats 2 or 3 students, and no table is empty. How many tables have three students?
How many canoes carry three campers? At summer camp, 22 campers paddle out in 9 canoes; each canoe holds either 2 or 3 campers, and none of the canoes is empty.

At the start of the day, the pet shop had 7 kittens and 6 puppies. In the morning, 4 of the kittens were adopted, and in the afternoon a shelter brought 5 more puppies. How many animals did the shop have at closing time?
follow_up_questions: The owner would like 20 animals for the weekend adoption day. How many more does she need?

problem: What is the number of cakes in the bakery window by evening? It opened with 7 chocolate cakes and 6 lemon cakes. A delivery of 5 more lemon cakes came after lunch, and 4 chocolate cakes were sold before lunch.
follow_up_questions: For the weekend the baker wants 20 cakes in the window. How many more cakes does she have to bake?

problem: A basket at the farm stand holds 6 green apples, 8 red apples and 5 yellow apples. A cat is asleep under the table. A shopper buys 11 apples for a pie. How many apples are left in the basket?
How many crayons are still in the box after Nia borrows 11 for her drawing? The box had 6 blue crayons, 8 green crayons and 5 orange crayons. Its lid shows a picture of a rainbow.
The library cart has 7 storybooks, 4 atlases and 7 cookbooks. Before the library closes, readers check out 9 books. How many books remain on the cart?
follow_up_questions: The following week, 6 books are returned to the cart. How many books are on the cart then?

problem: Find how many pencils stay in the art room jar. It held 7 red pencils, 4 black pencils and 7 purple pencils, and then the pupils took 9 home for homework.
follow_up_questions: A week later 6 pencils come back to the jar. How many pencils does the jar hold then?

problem: The toy box at the nursery has 5 puppets, 1 kite and 6 balls. Some children take 4 toys outside to play. How many toys are still in the box?
follow_up_questions: Later, 2 of those toys are brought back. How many toys are in the box now?
Then another group takes half of the toys in the box. How many toys do they take?

problem: How many films are left on the shelf at the community centre after a family borrows 4? There were 5 cartoons, one musical and 6 nature films.
follow_up_questions: Two of the borrowed films are returned that night. How many films does the shelf hold now?
A class then borrows half of the films on the shelf. How many films does the class borrow?

problem: A jar held 3 big buttons, 5 round buttons and 4 heart buttons. Grandma took some out to sew on a coat and left 6 in the jar. How many buttons did she sew on?
follow_up_questions: The coat needs 9 buttons in all. How many more buttons does Grandma need?

problem: How many beads did Zara thread onto her bracelet? Her pot had 3 glass beads, 5 wooden beads and 4 star beads, and 6 are still in the pot.
follow_up_questions: A finished bracelet has 9 beads. How many more beads does Zara need to add?

problem: Mr. Lindqvist had 6 yellow caps, 5 white caps and 4 black caps in his box before the swimming race. He gave some to the swimmers and kept 3. How many caps did he give out?
follow_up_questions: The swimmers wearing caps make teams of 4. How many teams are there?
Each team swims 5 lengths. How many lengths do all the teams swim together?

problem: How many name tags did the camp leader pass out, if she started with 6 orange tags, 5 purple tags and 4 grey tags and has 3 left now?
follow_up_questions: Campers with tags split into groups of 4. How many groups are formed?
Every group goes on 5 nature walks. What is the total number of walks?

problem: At the ice cream van, 3 people wanted cones, 5 wanted lollies and 5 wanted milkshakes. Then 4 of them gave up and walked away. How many people are still waiting?
follow_up_questions: Serving each person who is left takes 2 minutes. How many minutes until everyone is served?

problem: How many patients are still in the dentist's waiting room? There were 3 people waiting for a filling, 5 for a check-up and 5 for a cleaning, but 4 went home after a long wait.
follow_up_questions: The receptionist takes 2 minutes to check in each person who is left. How long will that take?

problem: On Friday the bookshop window held 4 copies of a mystery novel, 4 copies of a joke book and 3 copies of a cookbook. A big poster hung behind them. By the afternoon, shoppers had bought 7 of the books. How many copies were left?
How many board games remained on the toy shop table after customers bought 7? Before the sale it had 4 chess sets, 4 checkers sets and 3 dominoes sets. The shop smelled of fresh paint.
Some gardeners were planting trees in the park. Then 15 neighbours joined in, and 22 of the gardeners left to eat lunch. Now 46 people are planting. How many were planting at first?
follow_up_questions: Later that afternoon, 10 more people go home. How many are planting now?
Those still planting form 4 equal groups. How many people are in each group?
Each person in a group plants 3 trees. How many trees does one group plant?

problem: How many people were at the beach clean-up at the start? After 22 of the first helpers went home and 15 students arrived, there were 46 people picking up litter.
follow_up_questions: Later, 10 more helpers leave. How many are picking up litter now?
The remaining helpers split into 4 teams of equal size. How many helpers are on each team?
Every helper on a team fills 3 bags of litter. How many bags does one team fill?

problem: A bus was driving through the city with some passengers. At the next stop, 6 people climbed aboard and 11 stepped off. Then there were 31 passengers. How many passengers were on the bus before that stop?
follow_up_questions: At the stop after that, 8 more people get on. How many passengers are on the bus now?

problem: There are 31 swimmers in the pool now, just after 11 climbed out and 6 jumped in. How many swimmers were in the pool before that?
follow_up_questions: Then 8 more swimmers jump in. How many swimmers are in the pool now?

problem: A big bin at the sports shop holds 68 balls. Music plays loudly over the speakers. Of the balls, 23 are footballs, 19 are tennis balls and the rest are beach balls. How many beach balls are in the bin?
How many purple balloons are in the bunch? The bunch at the party has 68 balloons: 23 are red, 19 are blue, and every other balloon is purple. The party was held in the garden.
Tomasz picked 24 apples, 17 pears and 13 plums at the orchard. He put some of them in the big crate and kept 9 to eat on the way home. How many fruits did he put in the crate?
follow_up_questions: The crate was empty before and holds 60 fruits when full. How many more fruits will fill it?

problem: How many books did Adaeze give to the school library? She sorted 24 picture books, 17 comics and 13 chapter books, kept 9 for herself, and gave away all the others.
follow_up_questions: The library's donation box was empty and is full at 60 books. How many more books would fill it?

problem: The school kitchen had 38 large plates and 27 small plates. During the week, 21 large plates broke, and on Friday 15 more small plates arrived. How many plates does the kitchen have now?
follow_up_questions: Next week 3 plates break each day for 5 days. How many plates are left after that?
The kitchen gives a quarter of the remaining plates to the staff room. How many plates go to the staff room?

problem: How many bandages are in the first-aid box now? The box held 38 big bandages and 27 small ones. Over the week, 21 big bandages were used, then on Friday 15 small bandages were added.
follow_up_questions: The following week, 3 bandages are used every day for 5 days. How many bandages are left then?
A quarter of what is left goes to the sports coach. How many bandages does the coach get?

problem: A roll of ribbon in the craft room is 95 centimetres long. The children use 38 centimetres to wrap a present and 29 centimetres to decorate a card. How much ribbon is left on the roll?
follow_up_questions: They cut the leftover ribbon into 4 equal pieces. How long is each piece?

problem: What length of hose is left after a gardener cuts off 29 metres for the pond and 38 metres for the flower beds? The hose was 95 metres long at the start.
follow_up_questions: The leftover hose is cut into 4 pieces of the same length. How long is each piece?

problem: The zoo's penguin talk drew 75 visitors. Of them, 28 were students, 31 were teachers and the rest were parents. How many parents attended?
follow_up_questions: Every parent was given a pair of penguin stickers. How many stickers went to the parents?
The zoo had set aside 50 stickers for parents. How many are left over?

problem: How many adults came to the museum's dinosaur show if 75 people came in all, 28 of them toddlers and 31 of them teenagers?
follow_up_questions: Each adult received 2 tokens for the gift shop. How many tokens were handed to the adults?
The museum had prepared 50 tokens for adults. How many tokens were not given out?

problem: Mr. Novak brought 18 red pencils, 23 blue pencils and 14 green pencils to the art club. He gave some to the new pupils and took 8 back home. How many pencils did the new pupils receive?

How many seed packets went to the new gardeners? Aunt Selma carried 18 packets of carrot seeds, 23 of bean seeds and 14 of pea seeds to the garden club, handed some out to the newcomers, and brought 8 home.
Chiara saved 63 dollars from walking dogs. At the music shop she spent 9 dollars on guitar strings and 17 dollars on a songbook. How much money did she have left?
follow_up_questions: A guitar case costs 45 dollars. How much more money does she need to buy it?

problem: How much money is left for Jamal after buying a 9-dollar ball and 17-dollar shin pads at the sports shop? He had earned 63 dollars mowing lawns.
follow_up_questions: New football boots cost 45 dollars. How much more money does he need?

problem: Mira's scout troop gathered 38 sweaters, 27 hats and 19 scarves for the winter drive. They kept 14 items for the school lost-and-found and sent the rest to the shelter. How many items went to the shelter?
follow_up_questions: The shelter packs the items into boxes of 7. How many boxes does it fill?

problem: How many toys were given to the children's hospital? The class collected 38 teddy bears, 27 toy cars and 19 puzzles, kept 14 for their own classroom, and gave all the others to the hospital.
follow_up_questions: The hospital puts the toys in baskets of 7. How many baskets are filled?

problem: A furniture workshop built 60 chairs and 25 stools on Monday. On Tuesday it sent 48 of the chairs to shops and built 17 more stools. How many pieces of furniture were in the workshop at the end of Tuesday?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday it sent out 30 more pieces. How many pieces were left?
They are packed into crates of 6. How many crates are there?
Each crate weighs 9 kilograms. What is the weight of all the crates together?

problem: How many small bags of flour were in the mill at the end of Tuesday? The mill filled 60 bags of white flour and 25 bags of brown flour on Monday. On Tuesday it filled 17 more bags of brown flour, and trucks took away 48 bags of the white flour.
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday trucks took away 30 more bags. How many bags were left?
The leftover bags are stacked on pallets of 6. How many pallets are there?
The bags on one pallet weigh 9 kilograms. How many kilograms do all the pallets hold?

problem: Before the school play, the costume teacher counted 32 hats, 28 masks and 25 capes. After the show, only 61 of these could be found. How many went missing?
follow_up_questions: The next morning 15 of the missing pieces were found behind the stage. How many are still missing?
Replacements come in sets of 3. How many sets are needed for the pieces still missing?

problem: How many marbles were lost during the marble contest? The judge had counted 32 green marbles, 28 clear marbles and 25 striped marbles at the start, but only 61 were in the bag at the end.
follow_up_questions: Later, 15 of the lost marbles rolled out from under the benches. How many marbles are still lost?
New marbles are sold in bags of 3. How many bags would replace the marbles that are still lost?

problem: A school delivery box holds 82 notes. Of these, 47 are permission slips and 18 are party invitations; the rest are thank-you cards. How many thank-you cards are in the box?
follow_up_questions: Each thank-you card needs 2 stickers. How many stickers are needed?
The secretary has 40 stickers. How many will she have left after putting stickers on the cards?
She then buys 3 sheets of 10 stickers. How many stickers does she have now?

problem: How many tulips are in the big bucket at the flower shop? The bucket holds 82 flowers: 47 roses, 18 daisies, and the others are tulips.
follow_up_questions: The florist ties 2 ribbons on each tulip. How many ribbons does she use?
She started with 40 ribbons. How many ribbons does she have left?
Then she buys 3 packs with 10 ribbons in each. How many ribbons does she have now?

problem: The car wash cleaned 58 cars today. Bubbles floated all over the parking lot. Of those cars, 21 were red and 15 were white, and all the others were black. Find the number of black cars washed today.
How many hardbacks are on the library's returns cart? The cart holds 58 books; 21 are picture books, 15 are paperbacks, and the rest are hardbacks. A sleepy cat lies under the cart.
A chess club has 70 members. Of them, 24 signed up for the morning class, 19 for the evening class, and the rest have not chosen yet. How many members still need to choose?
follow_up_questions: Those members are split equally into 3 new afternoon classes. How many members are in each class?
Each new class then gets 2 more players from the waiting list. How many members are in each new class now?

problem: How many campers have not picked an activity yet? Out of the 70 campers at summer camp, 24 chose swimming and 19 chose archery.
follow_up_questions: The camp leader puts the undecided campers into 3 equal hiking groups. How many campers are in each group?
Later, 2 more campers join each hiking group. How big is each hiking group now?

problem: The art class cut out 64 paper snowflakes for the window. They painted 23 of them silver and dusted 17 with glitter. The others stayed white. Work out how many white snowflakes there are.
follow_up_questions: The white snowflakes are hung in 4 equal rows. How many snowflakes are in each row?

problem: How many cookies had no topping? A baker made 64 cookies for the fair: 23 got chocolate chips, 17 got sprinkles and the rest were left plain.
follow_up_questions: She packs the plain cookies equally into 4 bags. How many cookies go in each bag?

problem: The pet shelter received 93 donations on Saturday. A dog barked at every visitor. Of the donations, 37 were blankets and 29 were toys; the rest were bowls. How many bowls were donated?
How many green caps did the team shop sell this week? It sold 93 caps altogether, of which 37 were red and 29 were blue, and all the rest were green. The shop is right next to the stadium.
The library's reading festival welcomed 47 authors. Of them, 14 came from nearby towns, 12 came from the capital, and the rest came from abroad. How many authors came from abroad?
follow_up_questions: The authors from abroad came on 3 buses with the same number on each. How many came on each bus?
Every author from abroad needs a pair of tickets for the closing dinner. How many tickets is that?
The organisers had 50 dinner tickets. How many tickets are left?

problem: How many runners came from the mountain club? A charity race had 47 runners: 14 from the school, 12 from the hospital, and all the others from the mountain club.
follow_up_questions: The mountain club runners travelled in 3 cars with an equal number in each. How many rode in each car?
Each mountain club runner was given 2 water bottles. How many bottles was that?
The race had 50 water bottles. How many bottles remained?

problem: At the airport tonight, 74 planes are parked. Of these, 23 are cargo planes, 18 are small private planes and the rest are passenger jets. How many passenger jets are parked?
follow_up_questions: In the morning, 9 of the passenger jets take off. How many passenger jets are still parked?

problem: Out of 74 bikes at the school bike rack, 23 are blue and 18 are red. If all the others are silver, what is the number of silver bikes?
follow_up_questions: After school, 9 of the silver bikes are ridden home. How many silver bikes remain?

problem: Tomas keeps 81 marbles in a jar: 26 are blue and 37 are green, and all the others are red. How many red marbles does he have?
follow_up_questions: Tomas gives 5 red marbles to his neighbour. How many red marbles does he have now?
Then he trades for enough red marbles to have 30. How many does he get?

problem: In Grandma Lucia's recipe box there are 81 cards. Since 26 are cake recipes, 37 are soup recipes and all the rest are for bread, what is the number of bread recipes?
follow_up_questions: She gives 5 bread recipes to her granddaughter. How many bread recipe cards does she still have?
Next she writes enough new bread recipes to have 30 of them. How many does she write?

problem: A toy stall at the school fair began the day with 75 rubber ducks. Children won 38 of them, and the stall owner put 14 back in storage. How many rubber ducks were left on the stall?
The garden centre had 75 rose bushes this morning. Shoppers took 38 of them home, and the staff moved 14 into the greenhouse. Find how many rose bushes are still outside.

Aunt Mariam picked 64 apples from her orchard. Pear trees grow there as well. Her friends took 35 apples home, and 8 were bruised, so she fed them to the goats. How many good apples does she have left?
follow_up_questions: She bakes 6 apples into a pie. How many apples are left?
She puts the rest into bags of 5. How many bags does she fill?

problem: How many fish does Captain Rosa have left to sell? She caught 64 fish this morning. The sky was grey and windy. She gave 35 to the restaurant by the dock, and 8 were too small, so she threw them back.
follow_up_questions: She grills 6 fish for her crew's lunch. How many fish remain?
She packs the remaining fish into boxes of 5. How many boxes does she fill?

problem: Jonas went to the book fair with $60. He spent $17 on a comic and $25 on an atlas. How much money did he take home?
follow_up_questions: At home, his sister gives back $9 that she borrowed. How much money does Jonas have now?
He wants a $35 telescope. How much more money does he need?
His grandpa gives him $10, and he buys the telescope. How much money does he have left?

problem: What amount was left in Sakura's purse after the craft market? She had $60 when she arrived. A clay pot cost her $25 and a scarf cost $17.
follow_up_questions: Later her friend repays the $9 he owed her. What does she have now?
A $35 painting caught her eye. How much more does she need for it?
Her uncle hands her $10, and she buys the painting. How much money remains?

problem: Before the camping trip, the leader filled a cooler with 70 juice boxes. Raccoons ran off with 16, and the campers drank 29 at lunch. How many juice boxes were left in the cooler?
follow_up_questions: On the second day, the campers drank 12 more. How many juice boxes were left then?
A park ranger gave them 20 juice boxes. How many did they have now?
They shared them equally among 3 tents. How many juice boxes did each tent get?

problem: How many sandwiches remained after the picnic lunch? The cook made 70 sandwiches; seagulls stole 16 and the guests ate 29.
follow_up_questions: At dinner the guests ate 12 more. How many sandwiches were left?
A neighbour brought over 20 sandwiches. How many were there now?
These were split equally among 3 families. How many sandwiches did each family get?

problem: Old Mr. Bauer harvested 62 tomatoes from his garden this week. In the hot sun, 7 split open, and he sold 41 at the farmers' market. How many tomatoes does he still have?
follow_up_questions: The next morning he picks 9 more. How many tomatoes does he have now?
He slices 5 for a salad. How many tomatoes are left?
He packs the rest into trays of 6. How many trays does he fill?

problem: Lena baked 62 cupcakes for the bake sale. Of them, 41 were sold and 7 got squashed in the car. Find how many cupcakes she has left.
follow_up_questions: That evening she bakes 9 more. How many cupcakes does she have now?
Her family eats 5 after dinner. How many cupcakes remain?
She puts the rest in boxes of 6. How many boxes can she fill?

problem: A pottery studio made 55 mugs this month. A cafe bought 24 of them, and 18 more were packed into gift sets. How many mugs are still on the studio shelf?
follow_up_questions: Each gift set has 3 mugs. How many gift sets were packed?

problem: Grandpa Yusuf grew 55 pumpkins this autumn. How many are left in his field, given that he sold 24 at the market and wrapped 18 as presents for the neighbours?
follow_up_questions: He wrapped 3 pumpkins for each neighbour. How many neighbours got pumpkins?

problem: Selin's tub of building bricks had 96 bricks. Her baby sister hid 27 of them and the puppy carried off 35. How many bricks can Selin still build with?
follow_up_questions: Her sister brings back 11 of the hidden bricks. How many bricks can Selin use now?

problem: Arjun's sticker collection had 96 stickers. How many can he still put in his album now that his cousin has taken 27 and the rain has ruined 35?
follow_up_questions: His cousin returns 11 of the stickers she took. How many stickers can Arjun use now?

problem: Ravi counted the boats sailing into the harbor. 4 came in before lunch and one more arrived at sunset. How many boats did he count?
What is the total number of kites Mei saw at the beach, if 4 were flying when she arrived and 1 more went up just before she left?
A pet shop has 6 white rabbits and 7 black rabbits. How many rabbits does it have in all?
follow_up_questions: Each rabbit eats 2 carrots a day. How many carrots does the shop need every day?
The owner has chopped 4 carrots so far. How many more carrots must be chopped today?
Then 2 new rabbits arrive. How many rabbits does the shop have now?

problem: In the school aquarium, 6 fish are orange and 7 are striped. What is the total number of fish?
follow_up_questions: The class drops 2 food pellets into the tank for every fish each day. How many pellets is that per day?
So far 4 pellets have gone in today. How many more pellets need to go in?
Later, 2 new fish are added to the tank. How many fish live there now?

problem: The janitor changed 3 light bulbs in the gym and 2 in the hallway. The school was quiet after the holidays. How many bulbs did he change?
follow_up_questions: Every new bulb cost $4. How much did the bulbs cost?
He paid with a $50 note. How much change did he get?

problem: How many flowerpots did Imani paint? She painted 3 pots for the kitchen and 2 for the porch. Her brother played music in the next room.
follow_up_questions: Each pot cost $4 to buy. How much did the pots cost?
She paid with a $50 note. What change came back?

problem: There are 8 life jackets in the boat shed. When the next group of kayakers arrives with 5 more, how many life jackets will there be?
follow_up_questions: That afternoon 11 kayakers each wear one. How many life jackets are not used?

problem: How many pillows will be in the sleepover room once Kemi brings 5 more from her bedroom? There are already 8 there.

So far it has paid $96. How much does it still owe?

problem: Two brothers, Arjun and Dev, each caught 23 fish at the lake. They gave 20 fish to their neighbours. How many fish do the brothers have left?

problem: How many shells are left after the sisters give 20 to the beach museum? Rosa and Ines both collected 23 shells this morning.
follow_up_questions: The two sisters share the leftover shells equally. How many shells does each sister get?

problem: Before her birthday, Lina had 34 books on her shelf. After her aunt's gift, she has 52. How many books did her aunt give her?
follow_up_questions: She lends 20 of her books to the class library. How many are still on her shelf?
How many more books does she need to have 60 on her shelf?

problem: How many coins did Dad add to Omar's money box, if it held 34 coins before and 52 after?
follow_up_questions: Omar takes out 20 coins to buy a toy. How many coins are left in the box?
What number of coins must he add to reach 60 in the box?

problem: Theo needs 25 stamps on his library card to win a free book. He has 14 stamps so far. How many more stamps does he need?
follow_up_questions: This week he earns 6 stamps. How many more does he still need?
Next week he earns 8 stamps. How many stamps will be on his card then?

problem: To get a free smoothie, a cafe card must have 25 stamps. How many more stamps does Aroha need if her card shows 14?
follow_up_questions: She gets 6 stamps this week. How many more does she still need?
The week after, she gets 8 more. How many stamps will her card show then?

problem: Mr. Ito picked apples in his orchard. He put 18 into a basket for the kitchen and left 21 in a crate under the tree for his son to carry in. How many apples did he pick?
follow_up_questions: His son drops 3 on the way, and they bruise. How many apples are not bruised?
Mr. Ito packs the good apples into bags that each hold a dozen. How many bags does he fill?

problem: Lucia baked biscuits: 18 are cooling on the rack and 21 are already in the tin. What is the total number of biscuits she baked?
follow_up_questions: Her dog snatches 3 of them. How many biscuits are left?
She packs the remaining biscuits into boxes of a dozen. How many boxes does she fill?

problem: A riddle at the maths club says two numbers add up to 71. If the first number is 38, what is the second number?
follow_up_questions: Another clue says the second number is 9 more than a third number. What is the third number?

problem: Tariq pulled two cards from a magic hat. The numbers on them have a sum of 71, and one card shows 38. Find the number on the other card.
follow_up_questions: A third card shows a number 9 less than the other card. What number is on the third card?

problem: On Monday the bakery sold 63 croissants. On Tuesday it sold 17 fewer. How many croissants did it sell on Tuesday?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday it sold twice as many croissants as on Tuesday. How many was that?

problem: The lighthouse keeper counted 63 ships passing in May. In June she counted 17 fewer ships than in May. What was June's count?
follow_up_questions: July's count was double June's. How many ships passed in July?

problem: Mira went to the arcade with 41 tokens and came home with 26. How many tokens did she use on the machines?

follow_up_questions: Each box still in the truck holds 8 bottles of juice. How many bottles are still in the truck?
When a box falls over, 6 of those bottles break. How many bottles are left?

problem: How many parcels did the mail plane carry when it landed, if 37 were unloaded at the airport and 45 stayed on board for the next city?
follow_up_questions: Each parcel still on board holds 8 books. How many books are still on board?
At the next city, 6 of those books are found to be damaged and thrown away. How many books are left?

problem: The school choir knew 43 songs. For the winter concert it learned 16 new ones. How many songs can the choir sing now?
follow_up_questions: At the concert they sing 25 of them. How many songs did they not sing?

problem: How many tricks can the circus clown do now, if he could do 43 tricks and learned 16 more this season?
follow_up_questions: In tonight's show he performs 25 of them. How many tricks does he leave out?

problem: There are 23 children at the swimming lesson but only 16 floats, one for each child. How many children will have to swim without a float?
The school minibus has 16 seats, each for one pupil. If 23 pupils want to ride, find how many pupils must wait for the next trip.

The ages of the three children in the Ruiz family add up to 41 years. Mateo is 18 and Clara is 15. How old is the youngest child?
follow_up_questions: How many years older is Mateo than the youngest child?

problem: The ages of the three oak trees in the park add up to 41 years. The Big Oak is 18 years old and the Corner Oak is 15. How old is the third oak?
follow_up_questions: How many years older is the Big Oak than the third oak?

problem: For the fun run, the school promised to run 85 laps of the track. One class has run 23 laps and another class 36. How many laps are still to be run?
follow_up_questions: Three teachers each run 6 laps. How many laps remain after that?
The head teacher runs the last laps herself, 2 laps every minute. How many minutes does she need?

problem: How many laps of the lake still have to be rowed? The rowing club promised 85 laps for charity, and so far the girls' team has rowed 23 laps and the boys' team 36.
follow_up_questions: Three coaches then row 6 laps each. How many laps are left?
The club captain rows the remaining laps at 2 laps an hour. How many hours does she need?

problem: Three suitcases weigh 61 kilograms altogether. The first suitcase weighs 24 kilograms and the second 19 kilograms. How heavy is the third suitcase?

The first ferry waited at the pier for 12 minutes. The second ferry waited 7 minutes longer than the first. How many minutes did the two ferries wait altogether?
follow_up_questions: A cargo ship then waited at the pier for 15 minutes. How many minutes did all three boats wait in total?

problem: How long did the two buses spend at the stop together, if the morning bus stopped for 12 minutes and the evening bus stopped 7 minutes longer than that?
follow_up_questions: A school coach also stopped there for 15 minutes. What was the total waiting time for all three?

problem: There were 72 shopping trolleys lined up outside the supermarket. Morning shoppers took 19 of them, and afternoon shoppers took 28 more. How many trolleys were still in the line?
follow_up_questions: A worker brings 16 trolleys back from the car park. How many trolleys are in the line now?

problem: How many umbrellas are left at the hotel door? The hotel had 72 umbrellas for guests, and when the rain started, one tour group borrowed 19 and another borrowed 28.
follow_up_questions: In the evening 16 umbrellas are returned. How many umbrellas are at the door now?

problem: A painter bought a 64-litre drum of paint for the school hall. The team used 13 litres on the first day and more on the second day. The hall has big windows on one side. After the second day only 9 litres were left. How much paint was used on the second day?

How many metres of wrapping paper did the shop use on Saturday? On Friday it had a 64-metre roll and used 13 metres. The shop sells toys and games. By Saturday evening just 9 metres were left on the roll.
The ferry trip from the port to the island is 93 kilometres. In the first hour the ferry sails 38 kilometres, and in the second hour 31 kilometres. How far is it still from the island?
follow_up_questions: Near the island the ferry slows down and needs 3 minutes for every kilometre. How many minutes will the rest of the trip take?
From the island dock, a minibus drives the passengers 8 more kilometres to the hotel. How long is the whole journey from the port to the hotel?

problem: How many kilometres does the coach still have to drive to the capital? The motorway route is 93 kilometres long, and the coach drove 38 kilometres in the first hour and 31 in the second.
follow_up_questions: Roadworks slow the coach to 3 minutes per kilometre for the rest of the way. How many minutes does the rest take?
From the capital's bus station, a taxi takes the travellers 8 more kilometres to the museum. What is the total distance from the start to the museum?

problem: Maya's piano teacher wants her to practise for 75 minutes over the weekend. She played for 25 minutes on Saturday morning and 30 minutes on Saturday afternoon. How many minutes must she practise on Sunday?
follow_up_questions: In the end she practised twice as long as that on Sunday. How many minutes did she practise over the whole weekend?

problem: How long does Kofi still need to read on Sunday? His reading goal for the weekend is 75 minutes, and on Saturday he read for 25 minutes after breakfast and 30 minutes before bed.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday he actually read for double the time he needed. What was his total reading time for the weekend?

problem: A farm shop got 96 jars of jam. The owner put price stickers on 35 jars and her son on 42. How many jars still need stickers?
follow_up_questions: Her son stickers 11 more before closing time. How many jars are left for tomorrow?

problem: Of the 96 invitations for the school dance, Mr. Kim has written 42 and his helper Rosa 35. Find the number of invitations still to be written.
follow_up_questions: Rosa writes 11 more before lunch. How many invitations are left?

problem: Some photos were in Grandma's drawer. She stuck 24 of them into a new photo album and gave 9 to her sister. The drawer still holds 13 photos. How many photos were in the drawer at the start?

problem: How many stickers were in Ayo's tin before he stuck 24 into his sticker book and traded 9 with a classmate? There are 13 stickers left in the tin.
follow_up_questions: A page of the sticker book holds 6 stickers. How many pages do the stuck stickers fill?
His mum adds a pack of 30 stickers to the tin. How many stickers are in the tin now?

problem: Raj poured water from the garden barrel twice: 12 litres for the tomatoes, then 17 litres for the beans. A robin watched from the fence. That left 25 litres in the barrel. How much water was in the barrel to begin with?

follow_up_questions: The leftover rice is shared equally among 4 jars. How many kilograms go into each jar?

problem: How much paint is left in the big tin? It held 70 litres before the school painted the fence with 23 litres and the shed with 19 litres.
follow_up_questions: The leftover paint is poured equally into 4 smaller tins. How many litres go into each?

problem: Leo took 3 fishing rods and a 48-metre spool of line on his fishing trip. When he went home, only 9 metres of line were left on the spool. How much line had he used?
follow_up_questions: He had used the same length on each of his 3 rods. How much line did each rod get?
For his next trip he buys a spool twice as long as this one. How many metres long is the new spool?

problem: How many centimetres of ribbon did Hira use, if she started with a 48-centimetre ribbon and has 9 centimetres left after wrapping 3 presents?
follow_up_questions: She used the same amount on each of the 3 presents. How many centimetres did each present get?
Next time she buys a ribbon twice as long. How long is the new ribbon?

problem: A lighthouse has 88 steps. Ben climbed 35 steps, rested on a landing, then climbed 12 fewer steps than before. How many steps are left to the top?
follow_up_questions: He splits the rest of the climb into 3 equal parts. How many steps are in each part?

problem: How many pages of her 88-page comic does Isla still have to read? She read 35 pages on Monday, and on Tuesday she read 12 fewer pages than on Monday.
follow_up_questions: She reads the rest over 3 evenings, the same number each evening. How many pages does she read each evening?

problem: On Monday the swim team swims 9 lengths to warm up. On Tuesday the coach makes them swim 6 lengths more than that. How many warm-up lengths do they swim over the two days?
follow_up_questions: Each length takes them about 2 minutes. How many minutes did they spend on warm-ups?
Next week the coach wants only half as many warm-up lengths in total. How many lengths is that?

problem: How many pages did Nadia write in her diary over the weekend, if she wrote 9 pages on Saturday and 6 more pages than that on Sunday?
follow_up_questions: She needs about 2 minutes to write a page. How many minutes did she spend writing?
Next weekend she plans to write only half as many pages in total. How many pages is that?

problem: A wooden footbridge in the park is 86 metres long and has three parts. The first part measures 22 metres and the middle part 31 metres. What is the length of the last part?
follow_up_questions: A new section as long as the last part is added at the far end. How long is the bridge now?

problem: How long is the second carriage of the tourist train? The whole little train is 86 feet long; its engine is 22 feet long and the first carriage is 31 feet long.
follow_up_questions: Another carriage of the same length as the second one is hooked on at the back. What is the length of the train now?

problem: The cinema has 90 seats. A school group took 43 of them and a birthday party took 28. How many seats stayed empty?
follow_up_questions: A ticket costs 2 dollars. How much did the school group pay for its seats?
Then 12 of the birthday guests leave early. How many seats are empty now?

problem: How many bikes are left at the bike-share station? The station had 90 bikes this morning; a cycling club took 43 and commuters took 28.
follow_up_questions: Hiring a bike costs 2 dollars. How much did the cycling club pay for its bikes?

problem: The farm's water tank held 45 litres before lunch. The cows drank 17 litres and the horses drank 19 litres. The pigs splashed in a muddy pond instead. How much water was left in the tank?

follow_up_questions: The trolley can carry 40 kilograms. How many more kilograms could still be loaded onto it?

What do all three boxes weigh together?

problem: How much do the two pumpkins weigh together? Lily's small pumpkin weighs 8 pounds, and her big pumpkin weighs 15 pounds more than the small one.
follow_up_questions: Her wagon can hold 40 pounds. How many more pounds could she put in it?
Her brother's pumpkin weighs 3 pounds less than her big pumpkin. How heavy is his pumpkin?
How much do all three pumpkins weigh together?

problem: A hotel's guest book has 96 pages. After a busy summer only 17 pages are still empty. How many pages have been written on?

The manager will start a new book when only 6 empty pages remain. How many more pages can be written on before then?

problem: Out of the 96 pages in Kemal's sketchbook, only 17 are still blank. Find the number of pages he has drawn on.
follow_up_questions: He has drawn 5 animals on every page he used. How many animals has he drawn?
He plans to buy a new sketchbook when 6 blank pages are left. How many more pages can he use before that?

problem: The class was filling the paddling pool for sports day. Mr. Diaz poured in 23 buckets of water, and then Ms. Lee poured in 38 buckets. How many buckets of water did they pour in?
follow_up_questions: The pool still needs 19 more buckets to be full. How many buckets will they have poured in all once it is full?

problem: How much fuel did the two farmers put in the tractor's tank, if Ali added 23 litres and his neighbour Petra added 38 litres?
follow_up_questions: The tank needs 19 more litres to be full. How much fuel will they have added in all when it is full?

problem: A pair of trainers costs 37 dollars. Sana pays with a 50-dollar note. How much change does she get?

follow_up_questions: On Saturday it used 8 kilograms less cheese than on Friday. How much cheese did it use on Saturday?
How much cheese did it use over the two days?

problem: How many litres of milk did the cafe go through on Monday, if it used 34 litres for coffee and 19 litres for hot chocolate?
follow_up_questions: On Tuesday it used 8 litres less milk than on Monday. How many litres did it use on Tuesday?
What was the total amount of milk used on Monday and Tuesday?

problem: Ella took 82 cards to the trading card meet in her binder. She came home with only 27 in it; the others had been traded or sold. How many cards left her binder at the meet?
follow_up_questions: At the meet she also bought 14 new cards and put them in the binder. How many cards does the binder hold now?

problem: How many marbles did Diego lose or trade at the marble tournament? He arrived with 82 marbles in his pouch and left with 27.
follow_up_questions: On the way home he won 14 marbles in a last game and added them to his pouch. How many marbles are in the pouch now?

problem: In the standing long jump on sports day, Ivan jumped 34 inches and Mele jumped 47 inches. How much farther did Mele jump?
follow_up_questions: Their teacher jumped 9 inches farther than Mele. How far did the teacher jump?
How much farther than Ivan did the teacher jump?
After a month of practice Ivan jumps 15 inches farther than before. By how many inches does he now beat Mele's jump?

How much farther did the teacher's plane fly than Ben's?
Ben folds a better plane, and it flies 15 feet farther than his first one. By how many feet does it now beat Ana's plane?

problem: A new path through the park must be 70 metres long. So far 46 metres have been paved. How many metres still have to be paved?
follow_up_questions: The workers pave 6 metres each hour. How many hours will the rest take?
Every metre of the path costs 3 dollars. What does the whole path cost?

problem: How many metres of bunting are still to be hung? The school fair needs 70 metres of bunting, and 46 metres are already up.
follow_up_questions: The helpers hang 6 metres an hour. How many hours do they need for the rest?
The bunting costs 3 dollars a metre. How much does all of it cost?

problem: Pita's storybook has two parts. Part one has 28 pages and part two has 36 pages. How many pages long is the book?
follow_up_questions: The editor removes 9 pages from part two. How many pages long is the book now?

problem: How many minutes long is the school concert, if the first half lasts 28 minutes and the second half lasts 36 minutes?
follow_up_questions: The second half is shortened by 9 minutes. How long is the concert now?

problem: Tomas and Ayla ran once around the track. Tomas finished in 74 seconds, and Ayla was 15 seconds faster. What was Ayla's time?
follow_up_questions: In the next race Tomas cut his time by 9 seconds. How many seconds did he take?
How many seconds slower than Ayla's first time was that?

problem: How long did Mei take to solve the puzzle cube, if her brother needed 74 seconds and she was 15 seconds quicker?
follow_up_questions: On his next try her brother is 9 seconds faster than before. What is his new time?

follow_up_questions: Each jug holds 8 litres. How many jugs did they fill?

problem: How many litres did Grandpa use to water the garden? His rain barrel held 83 litres, and after watering only 11 litres remained.
